verdict.rationale: There is no documented local API, socket or query endpoint for live codes, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The closest programmatic surface is the official Ente CLI, which can automatically back up and decrypt Auth exports. That gives an agent scriptable access to the secrets only through an export-then-decrypt workaround, not a queryable endpoint. The enteauth://search deep link only opens a search inside the app UI. Missing for 10: a local queryable endpoint or API serving current TOTP codes, an agent-facing query interface, documentation of live programmatic access, and independent hands-on corroboration.
